question: How do the Yakṣas always protect the all-protecting goddess in the heart through remembrance?
premises: The Yakṣas protect this all-protecting goddess.
They protect her in the heart.
This protection is always maintained through remembrance.
inference: Remembrance in the heart sustains the protective presence of the goddess.
plain_english: The Yakṣas always protect this all-protecting goddess in the heart through remembrance.
